_about: A.S.R.A. Field Clearance: the player's standing with the agency, raised by Research Yield (RY) that the field scanner files on every new reading (scripts/GameLogicEngine/asra_clearance.gd). tiers: in order, each reached once lifetime yield hits its "yield"; "brief" is the line the promotion notice and the terminal header show. The yield rules themselves (what a reading is worth and its modifiers) live in the script's constants.

tiers.title: PROVISIONAL CONTRACTOR
tiers.brief: Onboarding in progress. Field scanner issued on a probationary licence.

tiers.title: ASSOCIATE FIELD SURVEYOR
tiers.brief: Probation lifted. Scanner calibration patch pushed to your unit.

tiers.title: FIELD ANALYST
tiers.brief: Hazard briefings unsealed. Your readings now count toward agency quotas.

tiers.title: SENIOR FIELD ANALYST
tiers.brief: Cross-level telemetry access granted. Peer review of your logs waived.

tiers.title: THRESHOLD SPECIALIST
tiers.brief: You are now cleared for unescorted deep-level survey.

tiers.title: PRINCIPAL INVESTIGATOR
tiers.brief: Dossier authorship rights granted. Your findings set directive policy.

tiers.title: DIRECTOR, NON-EUCLIDEAN OPS
tiers.brief: There is no further clearance. There is no way back up. Welcome to the board.
